name: Solid Rocket Port Unloader
description: Allows Solids to be unloaded from the storage of a linked rocket.Automatically links when built to the side of a Rocket Platform or another Rocket Port.Uses build-in solid material filters. Rockets must be landed to load or unload resources.
Requires: must be built next to Rocket Platform
Effects: Allows unloading of Solid Cargo Bays

name: Automation Broadcaster
description: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal to an Automation Receiver over vast distances in space.Both the Automation Broadcaster and the Automation Receiver must be exposed to space to function. Sends automation signals into space.
Auto In: Green: Broadcasts a green signal to reciever(s)Red: Broadcasts a red signal to receivers(s)

name: Radiation Sensor
description: Sends a  Green Signal or a Red Signal when ambient Radiation enters the chosen range. Radiation Sensors can disable buildings when they detect dangerous levels of Radiation
Auto Out: Green: When ambient Rads enters the desired range.Red: When ambient radiation is outside of the desired range.

name: Automation Receiver
description: Receives a Green Signal or a Red Signal from an Automation Broadcaster over vast distances in space.Both the Automation Receiver and the Automation Broadcaster must be exposed to space to function Receives automation signals from space.
Auto Out: Green: Green signals sent from a broadcasterRed: Red signals sent from a broadcaster

name: Wood Heater
description: Consumes Wood in order to Heat chilly surroundings. Wood heaters dry out soggy feet and help Duplicants forget how cold they are.
Requires: Wood 25 g/sDuplicant operation
Effects: Frost ResistanceCarbon Dioxide: +4000 mg/s @ 30 °C / 86 °F+ (Input-dependent) Light range: 6 tilesBrightness: 450 Lux

name: Wicker Door
description: Encloses areas without blocking Liquid or Gas flow.Wild Critters cannot pass through doors. A breezy wooden door combines style and function.

name: Conveyor Receptacle Fitting
description: Allows Solid Materials to be moved into rocket storage via Conveyor Rails. Why organize your shelves when you can just shove everything in here?
Requires: Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.Cannot be built on Window Tiles.

name: Liquid Rocket Port Loader
description: Allows Liquids to be loaded in the Liquid Cargo Tank of a linked rocket.Automatically links when built to the side of a Rocket Platform.Uses the liquid filters set on the linked Rocket Platform. Rockets must be landed to load or unload resources.
Requires: must be built next to Rocket Platform
Effects: Allows loading of Liquid Cargo Tank

name: Telescope
description: Reveals visible Planetoids.Assigned Duplicants must possess the Astronomy trait. Telescopes are necessary for studying space, allowing rocket travel to other worlds.
Requires: Duplicant operation

name: Targeting Beacon
description: Guides Interplanetary Payloads to land nearby.

name: Rocket Port Extension
description: Automatically links when built to the side of a Rocket Platform or any Rocket Port. Allows rocket platforms to be built farther apart.
Requires: must be built next to a Rocket Platform or Rocket Port

name: Materials Study Terminal
description: Conducts Applied Sciences Research to unlock new technologies. Comes with a few ions thrown in, free of charge.
Requires: 10 Radbolts per research pointDuplicant with Applied Sciences Research skillDuplicant operation
Effects: Produces Applied Sciences Research points

name: Payload Opener
description: Unpacks Interplanetary Payloads delivered by Duplicants or Auto-Sweepers.Automatically separates Solid, Liquid, and Gas materials and distributes them to the appropriate systems. Payload openers can be hooked up to conveyors, plumbing and ventilation for improved sorting.

name: Wood Tile
description: Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.Provides good insulation and boosts Decor, contributing to Morale. Rooms built with wood tile are cozy and pleasant.

name: Research Portal
Effects: Light Range: 5 tilesBrightness: 1800 Lux

description: Stores a small chunk of Oxylite which gradually releases Oxygen into the environment. Sconces prevent diffused oxygen from being wasted inside storage bins.
Effects: Storage Capacity: 240 kg Oxygen: 350 g/s (average from the Oxylite)

name: Orbital Data Collection Lab
description: Creates Data Banks that can be consumed at a Virtual Planetarium to unlock new technologies. Orbital Data Collection Labs record data while orbiting a Planetoid and write it to a Data Bank.
Requires: Active in spacePlastic: 5 kg per Research point.Duplicant operation
Effects: Orbital Research

description: Consumes Wood to melt Ice into Water, which can be bottled for transport. The water never gets hot enough to burn the tongue.
Effects: Melting Rate: 20 kg/sStorage Capacity: 500 kg water, 1000 kg ice, 1000 kg wood

name: Interplanetary Launcher
description:
Launches Interplanetary Payloads between planetoids. 

Payload can contain Solid, Liquid, or Gas materials. Cannot transport Duplicants. It's tempting to climb inside but trust me... don't.
Requires: Radbolt Input Port

name: Gas Intake Fitting
description: Allows Gases to be pumped into rocket storage via pipes. It's basically central-vac...
Requires: Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.Cannot be built on Window Tiles.

name: Gas Output Fitting
description: Allows Gases to be drawn from rocket storage via pipes. Refreshing breezes on-demand.
Requires: Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.Cannot be built on Window Tiles.

name: Liquid Output Fitting
description: Allows Liquids to be drawn from rocket storage via pipes. Now if only we had some water balloons...
Requires: Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.Cannot be built on Window Tiles.

name: Starmap Location Sensor
description: Sends Green Signals at the chosen starmap locations and Red Signals everywhere else.
Auto Out: Green: current location in filterRed: current location not in filter

name: Power Outlet Fitting
description: Provides Power to connected buildings. Pulls power from Battery Modules and Rocket Engines. Outlets conveniently power buildings inside a cockpit using their rocket's power stores.
Requires: Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.Cannot be built on Window Tiles.

name: Sludge Press
description: Separates Mud and other Sludges into their base Elements.Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued. What Duplicant doesn't love to play with Mud?

Effects: 60 kg Dirt and 90 kg Water or 60 kg Polluted Dirt and 90 kg Polluted Water

description: Emits radiation when powered that can be collected by a Radbolt generator. Duplicants can become sick if exposed to radiation without protection.

name: Printing Pod
Effects: Light Range: 5 tiles

name: Snow Tile
description: Used to build the walls and floors of rooms. Insulates rooms to reduce Heat loss in cold climates.Snow tiles have low thermal conductivity, but will melt if temperatures get too high.

name: Artifact Analysis Station
description: Analyses and extracts Neutronium from artifacts of interest.
Requires: Duplicant operation

name: Rocket Platform

Auto Out: Green: (1) Rocket is ready for flight; (2) Rocket is on the platform

name: Radbolt Joint Plate
description: Receives Radbolts from Radbolt Generators and directs them through walls. All other materials and elements will be blocked from passage. Allows Radbolts to pass through walls.

name: Radbolt Reflector
description: Receives and redirects Radbolts from Radbolt Generators. We were all out of mirrors.

description: Identifies new Seed Subspecies. Would a mutated Rose still smell as sweet?
